title: TRIM: Achieving Extreme Sparsity with Targeted Row-wise Iterative Metric-driven Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2505.16743v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) present substantial computational and memory challenges. Existing one-shot pruning methods often use a uniform sparsity target for all rows within a layer, which can be too coarse at high sparsity. This work introduces TRIM (Targeted Row-wise Iterative Metric-driven pruning), a forward-statistics-based wrapper that allocates different sparsity ratios to individual output rows while keeping model weights frozen. TRIM separates the choice of which weights to prune (scoring) from how many to prune in each row (allocation), and composes with existing scorers and layer-wise allocations. Across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-2, and OPT models, its largest gains occur at 70-80% sparsity. At 80%, adding TRIM to OWL reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 348.48 to 180.67 for Qwen2.5-14B and from 6461.43 to 324.14 for OPT-13B. translated_title: TRIM：通过目标行级迭代度量驱动剪枝实现极端稀疏化
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）带来了巨大的计算和内存挑战。现有的一次性剪枝方法通常对层内的所有行使用统一的稀疏度目标，这在高稀疏度下可能过于粗糙。本工作引入了TRIM（目标行级迭代度量驱动剪枝），这是一种基于前向统计信息的封装方法，能够在保持模型权重冻结的同时，为各个输出行分配不同的稀疏比率。TRIM将“剪枝哪些权重”（评分）与“每行剪枝多少”（分配）这两个问题分开处理，并可与现有的评分器和层级分配方法组合使用。在Qwen2.5、LLaMA-2和OPT模型上的实验表明，其最大收益出现在70-80%稀疏度区间。在80%稀疏度下，将TRIM添加到OWL上，可使Qwen2.5-14B的WikiText-2困惑度从348.48降至180.67，使OPT-13B的困惑度从6461.43降至324.14。我们得出结论，细粒度的行级分配是显著提升模型性能的有效机制。
tldr: TRIM提出一种行级迭代度量驱动剪枝方法，通过为层内每个输出行分配不同的稀疏比率，在高稀疏度（70-80%）下显著降低大语言模型的困惑度，例如使Qwen2.5-14B在80%稀疏度下的困惑度近乎减半。
en_tdlr: TRIM introduces a targeted row-wise iterative metric-driven pruning method that allocates different sparsity ratios to individual output rows, substantially reducing LLM perplexity at extreme sparsity levels (70-80%), such as nearly halving perplexity for Qwen2.5-14B at 80% sparsity.
